blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Tycoons Lance Gokongwei and Chito Salazar will share the coveted “Management Person of the Year” honor for 2026, awarded by the country’s influential group of business executives, the Management Association of the Philippines (MAP). Gokongwei, president and CEO of JG Summit Holdings Inc., earned accolades for transforming the Gokongwei Group into a professionally managed institution and for steering the companies under the conglomerate’s portfolio, including Cebu Pacific and Universal Robina Corporation.
